text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on our way back from an outing together,
Verxina suddenly called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Would you listen to my resolution, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I...
I've made up my mind to become the new queen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"My, how childish.
Is that really the temperature—of your love?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...!!
As expected... She looks completely different...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I see! So all I need to do is haul all these carts outside together, correct?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's a piece of cake!
Leave it all to my Princess Power!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Eh?! You're carrying all of them for us?!"
"We were in a real pinch, thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"To be that powerful...
She truly is beyond all measure...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Those hailed as "Queens"
possess a special brilliance that I lack.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "I wanted to adopt even a fraction of their brilliance and graceful demeanor."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "First—I would like to begin by imitating and learning."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Training to reach even greater heights
as a "Queen"...
Would you accompany me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's an outlandish idea... but analyzing other "Queens" should surely teach us something.
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was walking alongside Verxina,
who was trying her best to act alluring.

text_block_list.name: Street Singer
text_block_list.text:
La~ la la~♪
La~ la la, la la la... La... la la...

text_block_list.name: Street Singer
text_block_list.text:
Damn it!! No matter how much I sing, it still sounds like crap!!
I'm done with this~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
――... Oh my.
Are you stopping already?

text_block_list.name: Street Singer
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah!
I never had any talent for singing in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps, you may be right.
However...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It is still burning, you know?
—My soul, that is.

text_block_list.name: Street Singer
text_block_list.text:
...! ...Damn it.
If you put it like that...

text_block_list.name: Street Singer
text_block_list.text: How the hell am I supposed to just give up now?!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! That was some good encouragement!
Let's keep this momentum going. Next is—

text_block_list.name: Jogger A
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh!
A tree this huge fell right onto the path!

text_block_list.name: Jogger B
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, not after a storm like that...
Old trees just can't withstand it.

text_block_list.name: Jogger A
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, that's gonna be a problem!
That's my daily jogging route, after all...”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Oh dear me!!
Are all of you in trouble!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, a huge tree is blocking the path!
...Which means!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Tear 'em up, toss 'em down, full power!
It's time for the fighting "Queen" to take the stage~~~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Something like this is... a piece! Of! Cake! For me~!"

text_block_list.name: Jogger A
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Little lady, what in the world are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please stay back!
Now then, here I gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gr-grrr-thud-crashhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Joggers
text_block_list.text:
"O-Oohh?! As expected of an Umamusume!!"
"Thank you, you really saved us!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Verxina tried on various queenly personas
one after another, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I think... I'd like to continue
with this approach going forward!
choice_data_list: So you're going to challenge all kinds of queens?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes! I will continue to look up to various people and learn from their strengths.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If I keep learning at this pace,
I am certain I can become the greatest Queen!
choice_data_list: I'm so excited for what's to come!
So you're not going to show everyone the queen in you today?
Aren't you going to show everyone the queen in you today?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If I keep learning at this pace,
I am certain I can become the greatest Queen!
choice_data_list: I'm so excited for what's to come!
So you're not going to show everyone the queen in you today?
Aren't you going to show everyone the queen in you today?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Hearing you say that
makes all my hard work worth it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The process of becoming the ideal queen—
Please, watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's plan to learn from the Queens around her
seemed likely to continue for a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That should... wait until a later time.
Rushing to show it off now would only be an eyesore.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Like polishing a gemstone, I will polish myself.
Until I am worthy of a new crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's plan to learn from the Queens around her
seemed likely to continue for a while longer.
